ONT methylation with Modkit

Dorado calls modified bases from POD5, or reuses MM/ML calls in your BAMs. Modkit extracts CpG methylation. Select Sturgeon for CNS tumours or MARLIN for leukemias.

Assign samples to a CpG classifier

Choose from the specimen diagnosis: MARLIN for leukemia research or Sturgeon for CNS-tumor research. Drag cards or use their dropdowns. These assignments are separate from Cancer/Normal roles. Leave unknown or unsuitable samples in Unknown / do not classify. Only the classifier group selected below is saved and run; the other group is not queued. Use a separate project for each classifier, keeping the completed ONT project unchanged.
